name: Free Education Scheme
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Special fees and other non-refundable compulsory fees are paid as prescribed by Government and examination fee in full.
_eligibility_text:
1. The beneficiary should be a student.
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC).
1. The beneficiary should be studying 3-year undergraduate degree (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com.).
1. The beneficiary should be enrolled in a Government or Government Aided Arts and Science College.
